truth.the_law_this_round_adds: Authority over unseen hard environments requires a shipped Brain-owned no-inference adapter, pinned official harness bytes, fresh seeded tasks, hidden-test/solution boundaries and a distinct runner-owned reward log. A runner-owned hard-benchmark attempt is not §6 verification, not a benchmark score and not arbitrary purpose understanding; it only records what the official verifier actually observed.
